The
Structure

Common
Polyamines

This

the
chemical
composition
and
structure
of
the

common
polyamines :
putrescine ,
cadaverine ,
spermine ,
and
spermidine .
These

compounds
are
simple
carbon
chains
with
between
two
and
four
nitrogens .
Each

nitrogen
carries
a
positive
charge
under
physiological
conditions ,
making

polyamines
cationic
molecules .
Many
of
their
roles
in
cells
are
a
results
of
their

cationic
nature .
